text:
ash: heads-up — after the reshuffle this morning the ml-training namespace is causing a scrape fanout. remote_write queues in ap-sg are blowing up and we're seeing 504s to ingest.

maria: yup, p95 rw latency jumped to ~3s, queues depth up 8x. prometheus logs: "http: request canceled" and repeated timeouts to remote_write endpoint.

kevin: looks like the relabel config for our ServiceMonitors didn't remove the per-pod instance label after resharding. lots of exporters with unique pod names -> cardinality explosion.

julia: can we temp-drop the noisy exporters while we patch relabeling? e.g. drop action for exporter=benchmark-exporter and exporter=debug-runner

ash: tentative patch (tested locally):
```
relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: ["__meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_prometheus_io_exporter"]
    regex: "benchmark-exporter|debug-runner"
    action: drop
```
We need to push similar to staging serviceMonitors.

oncall: I pushed a quick scrape_interval override for the namespace to 60s and added a backoff on scrapes for those pods. That dropped immediate scrape rate by ~70%.

maria: good short-term win. but rw_queue_size is still elevated; remote_write p99 stays at ~5s. probably need to increase batch_max_samples and write_relabel_configs to drop low-value series.

kevin: agree. also saw a NAT ephemeral port exhaustion warning on the egress natgw for ap-sg — a lot of short-lived scrape connections. we should enable connection reuse and longer keepalives on prometheus sidecar.

julia: suggested write_relabel snippet to reduce series sent:
```
write_relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: ["__name__"]
    regex: "(container_cpu|container_memory)_(total|rss)"
    action: keep
  - regex: ".*"
    action: drop
```
This is aggressive but would limit payload while we do a proper fix.

ash: can we coordinate a safe rollout? plan: 1) apply drop relabel for exporters in staging (julia), 2) increase scrape keepalive and batch window in staging (kevin), 3) monitor remote_write queue and ingest latency for 30m, 4) if stable, roll to prod with canary region.

oncall: I'm on step 1 now for staging. tagging @maria for monitoring dashboards and SLO adjustments.

maria: updating dashboards: added a temporary panel for per-namespace remote_write_queue_size and a log-based alert for any namespace >1000 queue length. also lowering alert sensitivity during this incident window so noise doesn't swamp SRE channel.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: staging/service-monitor/ml-training updated by oncall at 2026-03-20T09:18:01Z :thumbsup:

kevin: FYI ops note — if NAT ports remain high after relabeling, we'll need to patch node-exporter sidecar to enable HTTP keepalive and reuse connections (Prometheus client config: dialer_keepalive: 30s). That should reduce conn churn.

julia: filing a small PR to central prometheus-operator: add default drop for known noisy benchmark exporters and a template for write_relabel_profiles. will link PR here.

ash: created incident ticket INF-2026-198 and added runbook steps and the rollback command. link: https://rwinf.atlassian.example/browse/INF-2026-198

maria: monitoring shows queue depth halved after the staging drop. p95 rw latency down to ~1.2s. moving to test keepalive patch in staging now.

oncall: staging keepalive applied, saw immediate reduction in short-lived connections. NAT port metric decreased ~60%.

ash: solid. plan to promote relabel + keepalive + write_relabel conservative profile to prod in 1hr if no regressions. kevin/julia own the rollout, maria keeps an eye on dashboards. I'll handle comms for customers if any residual tail latency.

ops-bot: prod rollout scheduled at 2026-03-20T10:30:00Z (canary region ap-sg first).

maria: action items summarized: [kevin] apply keepalive patch prod canary; [julia] merge relabel PR and prod config; [ash] customer comms + incident ticket updates; [oncall] monitor and rollback if remote_write errors spike. we'll reconvene in 45m.

kevin: starting prod canary now.

maria: P.S. postmortem note: we should add a CI lint check for ServiceMonitor relabels to prevent per-pod labels slipping through during reshard/reshuffle events. ticket created INF-2026-199.

ash: thanks all, closing slack loop and moving updates to the incident ticket. :white_check_mark:
